metadata.source: Adapted from Forbidden Lands Core Rules and historical Slavic material culture
metadata.region: Baltic Slavic territories (Pomerania, Polabia, Wendish lands)

items.name: Nóż (Knife)
items.notes: Universal utility and fighting knife. Found in every household.

items.name: Kosa (Sickle)
items.notes: Farming tool repurposed as weapon. Curved blade can hook and slash.

items.name: Topór (Hand Axe)
items.notes: Versatile tool and weapon. The most common Slavic sidearm.

items.name: Siekiera (Battle Axe)
items.notes: Purpose-built war axe with broader blade and longer haft.

items.name: Topór Dwuręczny (Great Axe)
items.notes: Two-handed axe. Requires great strength to wield effectively.

items.name: Miecz (Sword)
items.notes: Double-edged straight sword. Status symbol and effective weapon. Typically 80-90 cm blade.

items.name: Miecz Długi (Longsword)
items.notes: Longer blade (90-110 cm). Used two-handed. Often of Frankish or Scandinavian origin.

items.name: Szabla (Sabre)
items.notes: Curved, single-edged cavalry weapon. Influenced by eastern nomadic cultures.

items.name: Włócznia (Spear)
items.notes: Primary weapon of Slavic warriors. 2-2.5 meters long. Can be thrown or wielded two-handed.

items.name: Dzida (Javelin)
items.notes: Lighter throwing spear. Used by skirmishers and hunters.

items.name: Oszczep (Hunting Spear)
items.notes: Spear with broader head and crossbar, designed for boar and bear hunting.

items.name: Pika (Pike)
items.notes: Very long spear (3-4 meters). Used in dense formations.

items.name: Kij (Club)
items.notes: Simple wooden cudgel. Improvised weapon.

items.name: Maczuga (Mace)
items.notes: Wooden haft with iron or stone head. Effective against armor.

items.name: Buzdygan (Flanged Mace)
items.notes: Mace with protruding flanges. Concentrates impact force.

items.name: Cep (Flail)
items.notes: Threshing tool repurposed as weapon. Hinged striking head.

items.name: Młot (War Hammer)
items.notes: Two-handed hammer with flat striking face and sometimes a spike.

items.name: Siekierka (Hatchet)
items.notes: Small axe. Easily concealed and thrown.

items.name: Krótki Miecz (Short Sword)
items.notes: Blade length 50-60 cm. Secondary weapon or primary for lightly equipped warriors.

items.name: Nóż Bojowy (Seax)
items.notes: Single-edged fighting knife, often with 30-50 cm blade. Common among northern Slavs.

items.name: Kosa Bojowa (War Scythe)
items.notes: Farming scythe with blade reoriented to point forward. Improvised polearm.

items.name: Widły (Pitchfork)
items.notes: Farming tool with two or three prongs. Improvised weapon.

items.name: Młot Kowalski (Smith's Hammer)
items.notes: Heavy forging hammer. Devastating but unwieldy.

items.name: Bierka (Stick)
items.notes: Simple wooden stick. Minimal damage, but useful for fending off animals.

items.name: Siekiera Obuchowa (Bearded Axe)
items.notes: Axe with extended lower blade 'beard'. Allows hooking shields.

items.name: Korbacz (Whip)
items.notes: Leather whip. Little damage but can intimidate and control animals.

items.name: Nóż do Skórowania (Skinning Knife)
items.notes: Specialized curved blade for processing animal hides.

items.name: Dłuto (Chisel)
items.notes: Woodworking or stoneworking tool. Improvised stabbing weapon.

items.name: Kosa (Scythe - Full)
items.notes: Full-length farming scythe. Unwieldy in combat but devastating if it connects.

items.name: Siekiera Ciesielska (Carpenter's Axe)
items.notes: Straight-edged axe for woodworking. Can double as weapon.

items.name: Włócznia z Grotem Kościanym (Bone-Tipped Spear)
items.notes: Crude spear with bone or antler tip. Used by poorer hunters.

items.name: Sulica (Light Spear)
items.notes: Short, light spear for throwing or one-handed use.

items.name: Łuk (Bow)
items.notes: Simple self-bow made of yew, ash, or elm. Effective range ~50-80 meters.

items.name: Łuk Długi (Longbow)
items.notes: Taller bow (180-200 cm) with greater power. Requires significant strength.

items.name: Łuk Kompozytowy (Composite Bow)
items.notes: Made of wood, horn, and sinew. Short and powerful. Eastern influence.

items.name: Kusza (Crossbow)
items.notes: Simple wooden crossbow. Slow to reload but devastating. Germanic influence.

items.name: Proca (Sling)
items.notes: Leather or woven sling for throwing stones. Used by shepherds.

items.name: Strzały (Arrows, set of 12)
items.notes: Wooden shafts with iron or bone heads.

items.name: Bełty (Bolts, set of 10)
items.notes: Shorter, heavier projectiles for crossbow.

items.name: Kamienie do Procy (Sling Stones, set of 20)
items.notes: Round stones or lead shot for sling.

items.name: Oszczep (Javelin)
items.notes: Throwing spear. Effective range ~20-30 meters.

items.name: Sulica (Light Javelin)
items.notes: Very light throwing spear. Can be thrown further but less damage.

items.name: Łuk Myśliwski (Hunting Bow)
items.notes: Lighter bow for hunting small game. Quieter and easier to draw.

items.name: Harpon (Harpoon)
items.notes: Barbed spear with rope attachment for fishing or sea hunting.

items.name: Łuk Dziecięcy (Children's Bow)
items.notes: Small bow for training youths.

items.name: Kusza Mała (Light Crossbow)
items.notes: Smaller crossbow. Faster to reload but less power.

items.name: Strzały z Grotem Płomiennym (Fire Arrows, set of 5)
items.notes: Arrows with resin-soaked heads for igniting targets.

items.name: Tarcza Okrągła (Round Shield)
items.notes: Classic Slavic shield. 80-100 cm diameter. Wooden planks with iron boss and rim.

items.name: Tarcza Migdałowata (Kite Shield)
items.notes: Teardrop-shaped shield. Provides better leg protection. Frankish influence.

items.name: Tarcza Mała (Buckler)
items.notes: Small iron shield (30-40 cm). Used for parrying.

items.name: Tarcza Półokrągła (Half-Round Shield)
items.notes: Oval or half-round shape. Common among Baltic tribes.

items.name: Tarcza Pleciona (Wicker Shield)
items.notes: Lightweight woven shield. Offers minimal protection but very cheap.

items.name: Puklerz (Shield - Hide)
items.notes: Rawhide stretched over wooden frame. Common among poorer warriors.

items.name: Skórzana Kurtka (Leather Jerkin)
items.notes: Thickened leather tunic. Basic protection against cuts.

items.name: Skórzany Pancerz (Leather Armor)
items.notes: Reinforced leather with multiple layers or boiled leather plates.

items.name: Łuskowy Pancerz (Scale Armor)
items.notes: Iron or bone scales sewn onto leather backing. Byzantine influence.

items.name: Kolczuga (Chainmail)
items.notes: Interlocking iron rings. Premium armor. Usually Frankish or Scandinavian in origin.

items.name: Płytowy Pancerz (Lamellar Armor)
items.notes: Small rectangular plates laced together. Eastern influence. Excellent protection.

items.name: Skórzane Naramienniki (Leather Pauldrons)
items.notes: Shoulder protection, often reinforced with metal strips.

items.name: Skórzane Nagolenniki (Leather Greaves)
items.notes: Shin protection.

items.name: Żelazne Nagolenniki (Iron Greaves)
items.notes: Iron shin guards. Worn by wealthier warriors.

items.name: Pancerz z Kości (Bone Armor)
items.notes: Bone plates sewn onto leather. Used by poorer tribes.

items.name: Skórzana Kamizelka (Leather Vest)
items.notes: Simple leather vest. Minimal protection but cheap and common.

items.name: Pancerz Wzorzysty (Embroidered Armor)
items.notes: Decorated leather armor with metal studs or embroidery. Status symbol.

items.name: Płaszcz Bojowy (War Coat)
items.notes: Thick padded coat. Worn under mail or as standalone armor.

items.name: Skórzana Czapka (Leather Cap)
items.notes: Simple leather skullcap. Minimal head protection.

items.name: Żelazny Szyszak (Iron Helmet)
items.notes: Simple conical iron helmet with nasal guard. Standard warrior helmet.

items.name: Hełm z Przyłbicą (Helmet with Visor)
items.notes: Full-face helmet. Provides excellent protection but restricts vision.

items.name: Hełm Normański (Norman Helmet)
items.notes: Conical helmet with nasal and cheek guards. Scandinavian influence.

items.name: Skórzany Hełm z Żelaznymi Paskami (Leather Helmet with Iron Bands)
items.notes: Leather helmet reinforced with iron strips. Good compromise protection.

items.name: Czapka Futrzana (Fur Cap)
items.notes: Warm fur hat. Minimal protection but essential in winter.

items.name: Nóż (Knife)
items.notes: Utility knife for everyday tasks.

items.name: Krzesiwo (Fire Steel)
items.notes: Strike fire with flint. Essential for starting fires.

items.name: Krzemień (Flint)
items.notes: Flint stone for fire-starting.

items.name: Hubka (Tinder)
items.notes: Dried fungus or cloth for catching sparks.

items.name: Świeca (Candle)
items.notes: Tallow or beeswax candle. Burns for several hours.

items.name: Łuczywo (Torch)
items.notes: Resin-soaked wood. Burns brightly for ~1 hour.

items.name: Latarnia (Lantern)
items.notes: Metal lantern with horn or glass panels. Protected flame.

items.name: Wiadro (Bucket)
items.notes: Wooden bucket. For carrying water or other liquids.

items.name: Liną (Rope, 10m)
items.notes: Hemp rope. Essential for climbing, tying, and construction.

items.name: Siekiera (Axe)
items.notes: Woodcutter's axe. Essential for gathering firewood.

items.name: Piła (Saw)
items.notes: Hand saw for woodworking.

items.name: Dłuto (Chisel)
items.notes: Woodworking chisel.

items.name: Wiertło (Drill)
items.notes: Hand drill for making holes in wood or bone.

items.name: Młotek (Hammer)
items.notes: General-purpose hammer.

items.name: Gwoździe (Nails, set of 50)
items.notes: Iron nails. For construction and repairs.

items.name: Igła (Needle)
items.notes: Bone or iron sewing needle.

items.name: Nić (Thread)
items.notes: Linen or wool thread for sewing.

items.name: Skóra (Leather, square foot)
items.notes: Tanned leather for crafting repairs.

items.name: Tkanina (Cloth, meter)
items.notes: Wool or linen fabric.

items.name: Węgiel (Charcoal, sack)
items.notes: For fuel and forging.

items.name: Drewno (Firewood, bundle)
items.notes: Bundled firewood.

items.name: Worek (Sack)
items.notes: Coarse woven sack for carrying goods.

items.name: Miech (Bellows)
items.notes: For smithing and fire-making.

items.name: Kowadło (Anvil)
items.notes: Iron anvil for smithing. Very heavy and expensive.

items.name: Garniec (Pot)
items.notes: Clay cooking pot.

items.name: Naczynie Drewniane (Wooden Bowl)
items.notes: Carved wooden bowl.

items.name: Łyżka (Spoon)
items.notes: Wooden spoon.

items.name: Nóż do Rzeźbienia (Carving Knife)
items.notes: Small knife for wood carving.

items.name: Wędka (Fishing Rod)
items.notes: Simple fishing pole with line and hook.

items.name: Sieć (Fishing Net)
items.notes: Woven net for fishing.

items.name: Pułapka (Trap)
items.notes: Small animal trap.

items.name: Miotła (Broom)
items.notes: For cleaning.

items.name: Paznokieć (Nail, individual)
items.notes: Single iron nail.

items.name: Kociołek (Cauldron)
items.notes: Iron cooking cauldron. Expensive but essential for large households.

items.name: Kamień Szlifierski (Whetstone)
items.notes: For sharpening blades.

items.name: Płótno (Canvas, meter)
items.notes: Heavy linen fabric for tents or coverings.

items.name: Wosk (Wax, block)
items.notes: Beeswax for sealing, waterproofing, or candle-making.

items.name: Żywica (Resin, jar)
items.notes: Tree resin for waterproofing, glue, or torches.

items.name: Wrzeciono (Spindle)
items.notes: For spinning thread.

items.name: Krosno (Loom)
items.notes: Weaving loom. Requires significant space.

items.name: Chleb (Bread, loaf)
items.notes: Rye or barley bread. Lasts several days.

items.name: Kasza (Porridge, portion)
items.notes: Cereal porridge. Staple food.

items.name: Mięso Suszone (Dried Meat, portion)
items.notes: Dried or smoked meat. Lasts months.

items.name: Ryba Suszona (Dried Fish, portion)
items.notes: Dried fish. Common in coastal areas.

items.name: Miód (Honey, jar)
items.notes: Honey. Used as sweetener and for mead.

items.name: Sól (Salt, pouch)
items.notes: Essential preservative and seasoning.

items.name: Woda (Water, skin)
items.notes: Waterskin containing fresh water.

items.name: Piwo (Beer, jug)
items.notes: Ale or beer. Common drink for all ages.

items.name: Miód Pitny (Mead, jug)
items.notes: Fermented honey drink. Ceremonial and celebratory.

items.name: Kwas (Kvass, jug)
items.notes: Fermented rye drink. Refreshing and slightly alcoholic.

items.name: Orzechy (Nuts, pouch)
items.notes: Forest nuts. Good trail food.

items.name: Suszone Owoce (Dried Fruit, pouch)
items.notes: Dried apples, pears, or berries.

items.name: Bursztyn (Amber, small piece)
items.notes: Baltic amber. Highly valued trade good.

items.name: Futra (Furs, bundle)
items.notes: Beaver, marten, or squirrel furs. Valuable export.

items.name: Wosk (Wax, block)
items.notes: Beeswax. Important export for church candles.

items.name: Miód (Honey, large jar)
items.notes: Honey. Traded in bulk.

items.name: Żelazo (Iron, ingot)
items.notes: Raw iron. Essential for smithing.

items.name: Srebro (Silver, small bar)
items.notes: Silver bullion. Currency and prestige item.

items.name: Sól (Salt, large sack)
items.notes: Salt in bulk. Essential trade good.

items.name: Płótno (Linen, bolt)
items.notes: High-quality linen fabric.

items.name: Worek Płócienny (Canvas Bag)
items.notes: Simple bag. Holds ~10 kg.

items.name: Torba Skórzana (Leather Satchel)
items.notes: Sturdy leather bag with strap.

items.name: Plecak (Backpack)
items.notes: Frame backpack. Holds ~25 kg.

items.name: Skrzynia (Chest)
items.notes: Wooden chest with iron bands and lock.

items.name: Mieszek (Pouch)
items.notes: Small leather pouch for coins or small items.

items.name: Bułłak (Waterskin)
items.notes: Leather waterskin. Holds ~2 liters.

items.name: Koń (Horse, riding)
items.notes: Riding horse. Status symbol and essential for travel.

items.name: Koń (Warhorse)
items.notes: Trained warhorse. Very expensive.

items.name: Wół (Ox)
items.notes: Work animal. Plows and pulls carts.

items.name: Wóz (Cart)
items.notes: Two-wheeled cart. Drawn by ox or horse.

items.name: Łódź (Boat)
items.notes: Dugout canoe or plank boat. For rivers and coastal waters.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Gospodarz (Farmer)
npc_equipment_sets.description: A free farmer. Works the land and provides for his family.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Wojownik (Warrior)
npc_equipment_sets.description: A clan warrior. Armed and ready for combat.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Zamożny Wojownik (Wealthy Warrior)
npc_equipment_sets.description: A well-equipped warrior of high status.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Myśliwy (Hunter)
npc_equipment_sets.description: A forest hunter. Provides meat and furs.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Rzemieślnik (Craftsman)
npc_equipment_sets.description: A village smith, potter, or woodworker.
